Privacy notice

Updated 9 November 2026

This notice covers the YMG Events website at events.ymgconsultingservices.com. For questions about your personal information, contact Dante David / Your Magic Genie at hello@ymgconsultingservices.com.

Visiting this website

This is a public information website. It does not require an account. We have not added analytics, advertising pixels or marketing cookies. Hosting and security providers, including Cloudflare, may process technical connection information such as your IP address, requested URL and browser information to deliver and protect the website. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives the connection information needed to serve them.

Contacting us

The enquiry builder processes the details you enter within your browser. It does not submit them to a server, save them in a website database or send an email automatically. The “Open email app” link prepares a message addressed to hello@ymgconsultingservices.com in your chosen email application. You decide whether to send it.

If you send an enquiry, we receive the information you include, your email address and ordinary email metadata through our Google Workspace mailbox. We use this information to respond, discuss a possible collaboration and, where relevant, prepare a proposal or carry out an agreed service. We do not add you to a marketing list through this enquiry.

Use, retention and your choices

Enquiry correspondence is used to take steps at your request before a possible agreement, manage an agreed relationship and maintain necessary business records. We keep it only for as long as needed for those purposes and any applicable record-keeping obligations. Service providers process information according to their terms and privacy arrangements; processing may occur outside the European Economic Area.

You may contact us to request access, correction, deletion or restriction of your personal information, or to exercise other applicable data-protection rights. You may also raise a concern with the Italian data-protection authority, Garante per la protezione dei dati personali.

Other YMG websites

Other YMG destinations may have different functionality and their own privacy notices. This notice describes the event website’s current email-based contact process.
